# AbelianDecoders.SelectiveQFT

**选择后测量 QFT 环窗读出**

对归一态与正测度集后测量给出实际单 gate QFT 词的环窗 Born 质量、分层等式与支撑乘积消费。

**边界**：不覆盖完整 QFT 电路综合、非 dyadic 频率或 HSP 终点。

**覆盖等级**：A

## 声明

| FQN | 种类 | 源码 | 一句话 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.AbelianDecoders.SelectiveQFT.selective_fourier_support` | theorem | L56 | Conditioning on a positive-probability event produces a nonzero state with positive support size at most the cardinality of the selected set. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.AbelianDecoders.SelectiveQFT.selective_gate_joint_weight` | theorem | L71 | For a positive-probability selection, the selection probability times the subsequent readout weight after `U` equals the readout weight obtained from the unnormalized collapsed state. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.AbelianDecoders.SelectiveQFT.selective_qft_circular_window_actual_readout` | theorem | L89 | For a normalized state and positive-probability selection, each cyclic Fourier window of the conditioned support length has positive readout probability; the QFT circuit uses one gate and no queries, and satisfies the joint-weight identity. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.AbelianDecoders.SelectiveQFT.selective_qft_actual_support_product` | theorem | L120 | For a normalized state and positive-probability selection `S`, `N` is at most `S.card` times the support size after applying the QFT to the conditioned state. |
